This balanced multigraph decomposes into cycles; maximizing the number of cycles minimizes swaps. A most frequent value with multiplicity f forces at least f simple cycles, and the maximum possible sadness is n-f. Thus a linear-time topological cycle check after removing one most frequent value gives the criterion, retaining parallel edges and self-loops.
